benefits.title: Earn more from the same guests

retention.title: Repeat orders go to your channel, not the aggregator
retention.result: Aggregators charge 20–45% per order. Nyambot brings repeat orders back to your channel commission-free — more revenue from the same guests, and the guest stays in your database

details.intro: An aggregator is a valid channel for attracting new guests. But on repeat orders it keeps the guest for itself. The goal is to capture that lead into your own channel and make the guest personally yours.

items.question: Do guests need to install an app?
items.answer: No. The mini-app opens directly in Telegram or MAX — messengers already installed on most users' phones. No additional installation required

items.question: Is there integration with iiko or R-Keeper?
items.answer: Yes. Nyambot integrates with iiko and R-keeper: menu, prices, stop-lists and orders sync automatically — an order from the messenger is rung up in the till and sent to the kitchen. Nyambot also works fully on its own, without a POS

items.question: Can I connect multiple locations?
items.answer: For a single location — 4,900 ₽/month, everything included. For chains with 2+ locations — custom pricing. Contact support and we'll tailor the plan to your scale

items.question: How does order payment work?
items.answer: Online card payment via YooKassa can be connected for all locations at once or selectively. Guests pay directly in the messenger. Cash on delivery is also supported

items.question: What is a MAX bot and do I need it?
items.answer: MAX is a Russian messenger with a growing audience and mini-app support. Connection is optional but allows reaching additional audience and gaining a new stable sales channel at no extra cost

items.question: How does the trial period work?
items.answer: After signup we give 90 days free — no card and no crippled features: the full CRM, the «Crew» app, POS and delivery integrations. You set everything up yourself, and support answers questions at every step

items.question: Can Nyambot be used without couriers?
items.answer: Yes. You can set up pickup only or dine-in service — delivery is optional. And if you need delivery but have no couriers of your own, connect Yandex.Delivery: Nyambot places the request once the order is ready and a courier comes for it. The Crew app and your own courier module are included in the plan too, but optional

items.question: How quickly can I start accepting orders?
items.answer: The order is: create a bot, connect it in the CRM, upload the menu, set delivery zones and share the link with guests. All of it is done in the CRM yourself, and support helps along the way
